newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Haixin buys woollen firm.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Haixin buys woollen firm.

text.p: Shanghai Haixin Co, a textile maker, said on Tuesday it planned to acquire controlling shares in a woollen spinning firm, a company statement said.
The company will pay 26.892 million yuan to buy a 72 percent stake in Shanghai Haixin Woollen Spinning Co, the statement said. The acquisition needs the approval of a shareholders meeting.
The company has signed an agreement with Haixin Woollen, agreeing that the acquisition will take effect from January 1, 1997 if the shareholders approve the plan.
The statement said Haixin Woollen had close links with Shanghai Haixin's business and the acquisition would help Shanghai Haixin to reduce production costs.
